acceptance.description: EDL schema: empty music slots, end card disabled by default, strict models, timeline maths, hash, save/load, presets, settings, stage order
ASS presets, safe-zone margins, Devanagari style, karaoke only with word timing, aligner
caption text edit changes EDL and .ass with no voice take; build_edl, gating, API, edit ops
one timeline edit after debounce enqueues exactly one assemble_preview and no assemble_final
preview 540x960; final 1080x1920/24fps/High/yuv420p/AAC 48k stereo/faststart; duration within 50 ms of EDL
loudness near -14 LUFS, true peak at most -1 dBTP on golden media
filtergraph script next to each output; same EDL yields preview and final
dialogue lands at EDL offset within one frame; silent shot gives silence and no error
kill and resume at every render step; completed steps not re-run
credits.json per model; licence warning 409 for non-commercial or unfilled licence; cancel enqueues nothing
range requests give 206 with Content-Range on the exported file
second export makes v2, v1 unchanged; reopen v1 loads its EDL; open-version errors; export writes v001
full mock pipeline story-to-export with a network guard, zero outbound connections
assemble_preview and assemble_final registered, no GPU lease, per-step progress
Assembly stage derivation before export stays as it is
